patch.summary: National parental-rights advocacy organization offering membership, local chapters, education resources and events.
patch.description: Moms for Liberty describes itself as a national 501(c)(4) nonprofit focused on parental rights and education advocacy. Its website provides parent resources, training, events and a chapter finder. National membership is free and distinct from joining a local chapter. This entry represents the national organization, not a verified New Hampshire chapter. The original imported link describes a past workshop in Concord on January 30, 2026; it remains an additional historical resource, not current event registration.
patch.accessInstructions: Visit the official homepage and select Membership for national registration, or Chapters → Find my chapter for local participation. Registration takes place on the organization's own site and may request contact information; Porcupine Directory does not collect or forward that information. Confirm chapter availability and event requirements with the organization.
